title: Laptop to committer
caption: Your change is built, tested, formatted and documented on your laptop, then travels as a patch through the mailing list and Commitfest to a committer.

title: Eight steps to a patch
caption: Follow the numbers from building the tree to a committer pushing your patch, with the real command under each step.

badges.meaning: Build the tree with meson and ninja, or configure and make
Add a SQL file, an expected output file and a parallel_schedule entry
Run the tests with make check-world or meson test
Format your C changes with pgindent
Update the SGML docs and check them with make html
Make a patch file with git format-patch
Register in a Commitfest, get review, then a committer pushes it

title: Anatomy of a test
caption: One regression test is a SQL file, an expected output file and a schedule line; a failed run writes regression.diffs, and isolation specs and TAP scripts cover other kinds of tests.
